state.background: This is a distinct post-evidence initial reevaluation of results/plan46/phase5/browser-mode-consolidation-plan-2026-09-29.md, not a clarification/follow-up chain. The earlier JEV result remains unresolved/incomplete and is not treated as approval. This revised plan includes exact predicates for the 17 active component consolidations and a case-level Phase 5 matrix of 17 exact transfers, 12 assertion transfers, and 2 held cases (#99 and #249). It preserves the 24 held component cases, excludes 9 DOM migration cases, and leaves other active route .ts cases unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The 17 active component candidates and destinations are accurate. For mobile-ux-47/65 at 375px, add the actual [class*='chartContainer'] scrollWidth <= clientWidth predicate while preserving the existing document-root overflow assertion.

For both MonthlyBoundaryAxis CPI and earnings transfers, preserve absence of both boundary labels and add a visible-first-tick assertion so the omission check cannot pass vacuously. Other active component destinations preserve the exact or superset contract listed in the plan.

The Phase 5 matrix accounts for all 31 case labels with 17 exact, 12 assertion-transfer, and 2 held statuses. It explains that wrappers assert observed IDs while matchesSourceContract/mismatch captures the declared diagnostic contract; raw measurement fields are not automatically pass conditions.

Phase 5 interaction transfers preserve these contracts: B07 #21 Flight rows/endpoints; B07 #60 zero captured errors after settle; B07 #82 section visibility; B08 #128 details open=false (empty legend is allowed); B08 #156 detailsOpen=true; B09 #174 summaryVisible only; B10 #138 tooltip hidden after close; B10 #159 close visible after retap; B10 #188 tooltip hidden after outside; B11 #207 one guide line; B11 #284 tooltip visible after retap; B12 #307 URL/hash unchanged; B12 #430 navigation/dismissal; B13 #473/#508/#535 their purposeful touch dismissal contracts.

B08 #99 remains held because local consumption legend behavior differs from the page-global first-legend destination; B11 #249 remains held because the destination early return does not prove dispatched gesture or chart-hit origin. Do not count either for deletion unless the destination is deliberately strengthened and verified.

Rendering contracts are case-specific: B02 default/dark, B04 CPI/earnings/new-graph, B05 residual/stacked, B06 Plan27 #79 and Plan23 #26 are exact; B03 advanced query/parity anchors/hidden-series and B06 Plan27 #9 receive the listed additional predicates.

The plan sets maximum deletion at 17 component plus 29 Phase 5 cases (46 total), retains two Phase 5 cases and both source files, preserves dirty worktree changes, and lists repository verification candidates without claiming they were run.
verification: Revised case inventory and mapping are documented in the plan at results/plan46/phase5/browser-mode-consolidation-plan-2026-09-29.md.
The change is a plan-only update based on the corrected source/route audit; no implementation or tests were run as part of this reevaluation request preparation.
This request uses the local initial v3 schema with evaluationScope=plan_validity. It is a new initial review after added evidence; it does not overwrite or reinterpret the earlier unresolved result.
knownConstraints: Shared worktree has unrelated staged and unstaged changes; preserve them and modify only planned cases during implementation.
The 31 Phase 5 cases are outside the standard Browser Mode config union, so removing 29 wrappers does not reduce active batch runtime.
B08 #99 and B11 #249 are hold cases, not deletion proof gates; retain both wrappers and source files under the current destinations.
For real-accordion-style, only summaryVisible is the purposeful predicate transferred to B09 #174; style measurements are diagnostics, while actual default/dark contrast cases stay at B02.
Runtime effect of active route assertion additions is unmeasured.
The previous JEV result remains unresolved/incomplete; this request is a separate reevaluation and does not imply the earlier result passed.
